title: Especialista em Engenharia de Processos e Projetos
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados. Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.

Na Caltec, acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossa equipe e que cada pessoa tem um talento único para contribuir. Essa vaga também se destina a pessoas com deficiência (PCD) ou reabilitados(as).

Atividades

  • Liderar a transição de novos produtos para a escala industrial, definindo fluxogramas de processo (PFD) e diagramas de instrumentação (P&ID);
  • Desenvolver e disponibilizar o pacote de engenharia básica para os departamentos de Obras e Meio Ambiente, incluindo dados preliminares, conceitos de projeto, escopos, especificações técnicas, locações, desenhos básicos e a definição dos principais equipamentos e sistemas industriais;
  • Elaborar orçamentos com alto grau de precisão, aplicando metodologias como FEL 2/3 ou equivalentes, assegurando a viabilidade econômica dos projetos;
  • Calcular indicadores de viabilidade econômica, como ROI e Payback, além de analisar os impactos dos novos projetos no custo operacional (OPEX) da produção;
  • Desenvolver o cronograma macro de montagem industrial, considerando paradas de planta e interfaces com a operação existente, visando minimizar impactos na produção;
  • Promover a internalização de tecnologias alinhadas à cultura da empresa, identificando oportunidades de fabricação interna e de aquisição externa, otimizando a utilização da oficina própria de caldeiraria e mecânica.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior concluído em Engenharia Química;
  • Sólida vivência em indústrias de mineração, siderurgia, química, papel e celulose ou sucroalcooleiro;
  • Experiência técnica em projetos que envolvam termodinâmica, transformação de materiais, transporte e escoamento de sólidos, líquidos e gases a granel;
  • Domínio de metodologias (PMBOK) e softwares de planejamento (MS Project);
  • Inglês avançado.

Desejável

  • Desejável conhecimento em SolidWorks e AutoCAD.

title: Head of Sales and Business Development
description:
Sales & Business Development Leader – LATAM

Location: Brazil | Work Model: Remote

Region: Latin America (LATAM)

About the Company

Our client is a global innovator in high-performance polymer and flash-spun material technologies, providing advanced material solutions across industrial protection, healthcare, technical textiles, semiconductor, packaging, and sustainable applications.

Driven by innovation and scalable manufacturing capabilities, the company delivers application-oriented B2B solutions to customers worldwide through established industrial and distribution networks.

As part of its global expansion, the company is now building its presence across Latin America and is looking for an entrepreneurial commercial leader to establish and grow the regional business.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Sales & Business Development Leader based in Brazil to lead the development of the company's protective garments and apparel business across LATAM.

The role will focus on both branded material solutions used in protective garment manufacturing and a portfolio of finished protective clothing. The successful candidate will combine strong industry knowledge with commercial and technical capabilities, helping customers identify the right solutions based on performance, regulatory, application, and supply chain requirements.

As the first commercial hire in LATAM, this is a highly entrepreneurial role. The successful candidate will be expected to build the market from the ground up — identifying opportunities, developing customer relationships, establishing distribution channels, supporting product trials, and converting opportunities into sustainable revenue.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development & Market Building

  • Develop and execute the LATAM business development strategy for protective apparel, disposable garments, PPE, and technical clothing.
  • Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities with garment manufacturers, converters, distributors, PPE brands, and end users.
  • Build the company's customer and partner network across key LATAM markets.
  • Identify target accounts, applications, market segments, and new routes to market.
  • Establish and expand the company's presence and brand recognition in the regional protective apparel market.
  • Develop the business from an early-stage market position, taking ownership from lead generation through to commercial execution.

2. Portfolio Sales

  • Promote and sell branded high-performance materials used in the production of protective garments.
  • Develop sales of the company's finished protective garment portfolio.
  • Understand customer requirements and recommend the most appropriate solution based on performance, application, regulatory, cost, and supply chain considerations.
  • Develop commercial proposals, negotiate with customers, and manage the sales cycle through to closure.
  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular forecasts and market updates.

3. Technical & Application Support

  • Advise customers on material selection and protective garment performance requirements.
  • Support technical discussions relating to fabric performance, barrier properties, material selection, garment construction, and manufacturing processes.
  • Work closely with customers and internal technical teams on product trials, testing, qualification, and garment evaluations.
  • Translate customer requirements into practical material and product solutions.
  • Support customers through product evaluation, qualification, and onboarding.

4. Market Development & Intelligence

  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer needs, and regulatory developments across LATAM.
  • Identify emerging applications and growth opportunities within protective clothing, disposable garments, PPE, and technical textiles.
  • Develop market intelligence and provide actionable insights to global product, R&D, and commercial teams.
  • Identify opportunities for new products, applications, partnerships, and market entry strategies.
  • Represent the company at relevant industry events, exhibitions, and customer forums.

5. Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Build long-term relationships with garment manufacturers, distributors, PPE brands, procurement teams, and key end users.
  • Conduct customer visits, product presentations, technical discussions, and commercial negotiations.
  • Develop strong relationships across technical, procurement, commercial, and senior management levels.
  • Support customers throughout product evaluation, qualification, implementation, and ongoing business development.
  • Develop and manage strategic distributors and channel partners where appropriate.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with global sales, marketing, product development, R&D, technical, operations, and supply chain teams.
  • Bring LATAM customer and market requirements into global product and commercial discussions.
  • Coordinate customer projects and ensure effective follow-up from opportunity identification through commercialization.

Requirements

Experience & Technical Knowledge

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant sales or business development experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • Protective garments / protective apparel
  • Disposable apparel
  • PPE products
  • Technical textiles
  • Nonwoven materials
  • High-performance materials used in protective clothing
  • Proven experience working with garment manufacturers, converters, distributors, PPE brands, or industrial end users.
  • Good understanding of materials used in protective clothing, including nonwovens, laminates, technical fabrics, polymers, or barrier materials.
  • Understanding of protective clothing standards, certification, and performance requirements is highly desirable.
  • Experience selling finished protective garments or PPE products is a strong advantage.
  • Technical knowledge of textiles, materials science, polymer engineering, or a related field is preferred.

Commercial Capabilities

  • Strong track record in B2B sales and business development, preferably within technical or engineered products.
  • Ability to develop new markets and generate business from a relatively low existing customer base.
  • Strong consultative selling and solution-selling capabilities.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Comfortable engaging with both technical stakeholders and senior commercial/procurement decision-makers.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand customer economics and supply chain requirements.

Languages

  • Fluent English is required.
  • Portuguese is required for the Brazil-based role.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, hands-on, commercially driven, and comfortable operating in a build-up environment.

As the company's first commercial hire in LATAM, this person will not simply manage an existing customer base. They will be expected to build the business from scratch — identify prospects, open doors, develop relationships, create opportunities, support technical evaluations, establish channels, and ultimately generate sustainable revenue.

The successful candidate will combine deep knowledge of protective garments and technical textiles with strong commercial execution, enabling the company's branded materials and protective clothing solutions to become preferred solutions for customers across multiple industries.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership and operates with a high level of autonomy.
  • Is comfortable being hands-on across the entire sales cycle.
  • Has a strong hunter mentality and enjoys opening new markets.
  • Can build relationships from scratch and turn technical discussions into commercial opportunities.
  • Is technically credible with customers while remaining commercially focused.
  • Is willing to travel extensively across LATAM as the business develops.
  • Can work effectively with a global organization and multicultural teams.
  • Is excited by the opportunity to build something new and create the foundation for the company's LATAM business.

What Makes This Opportunity Attractive?

  • First commercial hire in LATAM with significant ownership and visibility.
  • Opportunity to build a regional business from the ground up.
  • Exposure to innovative high-performance polymer and advanced material technologies.
  • Direct interaction with global commercial, technical, and R&D teams.
  • Broad responsibility covering business development, sales, technical application, and market development.
  • Opportunity to shape the company's LATAM go-to-market strategy and long-term regional growth.
  • Remote-based position in Brazil with significant regional responsibility.

title: Logistics Specialist- First Mile
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

Key Responsibilities

  • Pickup Operations Management: Oversee daily pickup operations across Brazil, ensuring sellers are collected within SLA and operational targets. Coordinate pickup flows with logistics providers, monitor execution quality, and proactively address operational risks, delays, and capacity constraints.
  • Supplier Coordination & Performance Management: Manage relationships with pickup service providers and carriers, conducting regular operational reviews, aligning volume forecasts, and ensuring compliance with company standards and KPIs. Drive accountability and corrective actions when performance deviations occur.
  • Data Analysis & Decision Making: Analyze operational data, pickup performance, seller behavior, capacity utilization, and cost indicators to support strategic and operational decision-making. Develop reports and dashboards to identify trends, operational bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Operational Planning & Execution: Support short-, medium-, and long-term pickup planning, balancing operational efficiency, service quality, and cost optimization. Coordinate operational contingencies during peak periods and large-scale campaigns.
  • Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement: Identify operational gaps and implement initiatives to improve pickup efficiency, reduce failures, enhance seller experience, and optimize operational costs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve systems, operational processes, and execution standards.
  • Incident Management & Escalation Handling: Lead operational issue resolution related to pickup execution, seller complaints, collection failures, and supplier performance. Ensure fast escalation, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive actions.
  • Field Operations & Seller Experience: Conduct field visits with logistics providers and sellers to validate operational standards, improve pickup experience, and ensure operational compliance. Maintain close visibility of frontline operational challenges.
  • Strategic Projects & Network Development: Support strategic initiatives related to pickup network expansion, operational model optimization, collection point management, and logistics performance improvement projects.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in logistics operations in Brazil, preferably in e-commerce, express logistics, or first mile operations.
  • Strong knowledge of pickup operations, logistics supplier management, operational KPIs, and field execution.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Strong analytical skills with the ability to make operational decisions based on data, performance indicators, and operational trends.
  • Operational & Analytical Profile: Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution in a fast-paced environment.

Na Cacau todos são Show!!!

Se você é apaixonado pelo que faz, possui senso de dono e muito "gás" para trabalhar, essa vaga é a sua cara!!!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Mapeamento de impacto tributário na base de fornecedores, identificar por categoria de gasto, como a transição PIS/COFINS/ICMS/ISS/ CBS/IBS afeta o custo real de aquisição, o crédito recuperável e a margem efetiva de cada fornecedor;
  • Suporte a renegociação de preços e TCO: auxílio na condução de renegociações baseadas no novo regime de créditos, garantindo que a economia tributária gerada pela não cumulatividade seja apropriada pela empresa (e não retida pelo fornecedor);
  • Revisão e adequação contratual: identificar contratos vigentes que necessitam de atualização de cláusulas tributárias, critérios de reajuste, repasse de custos e condições de pagamento;
  • Qualificação e monitoramento fiscal de fornecedores: implementar critérios ampliados de due diligence fiscal no onboarding e no ciclo de vida do fornecedor, com foco no risco de perda de crédito tributário por inadimplência do parceiro;
  • Análise de sourcing sob a nova ótica de destino: reavaliar decisões de sourcing nacional e regional que dependiam de incentivos fiscais de ICMS, considerando custo logístico total, nível de serviço e nova carga tributária efetiva;
  • Gestão do impacto no working capital: Suporte no mapeamento do efeito da reforma no fluxo de caixa de compras por categoria, em colaboração com Tesouraria e Controladoria;
  • Identificação de oportunidades de crédito: identificar categorias de gasto que passarão a gerar crédito (serviços, locações, transporte) e quantificar o benefício financeiro potencial;
  • Apoio à parametrização de sistemas (ERP/SRM): atuar como bridge entre Compras e as áreas de TI/Fiscal na atualização de cadastros de fornecedores, códigos tributários, parametrizações de CBS/IBS no sistema de compras e processos de source-to-pay;
  • Construção de dashboards e relatórios de risco: desenvolver e manter visões analíticas de exposição tributária por fornecedor, categoria e contrato, para subsídio ao Comitê de Reforma Tributária;
  • Interlocução com o Squad de Reforma Tributária: representar área de Compras no squad multidisciplinar, trazendo a visão de procurement para decisões de malha logística, footprint e estratégia de suprimentos;
  • Entregáveis esperados;
  • Matriz de impacto tributário por categoria de gasto (mapeamento CBS/IBS × PIS/COFINS/ICMS/ISS atual);
  • Plano de renegociação de preços priorizado por potencial de captura de valor;
  • Relatório de gap contratual (contratos que requerem aditivos tributários);
  • Scorecard de risco fiscal de fornecedores críticos;
  • Dashboard de exposição ao split payment por categoria;
  • Plano de ação de resourcing/realocação de fornecedores (se aplicável);

Royal Enfield - About Us

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India's middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfield is engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It's an approach to the brand called Pure Motorcycling.

Royal Enfield's premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from

adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company's worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield's first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY '24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Trainee | Assessoria de Investimentos do Banco Safra
description:
Sobre a Quark

Somos uma assessoria de investimentos credenciada pelo Banco Safra — a solidez de um banco com mais de 180 anos somada à agilidade de uma assessoria. Em poucos anos, passamos de R$1 bilhão sob custódia, com cerca de 70 assessores e mais de 3.000 clientes. Fomos eleitos Revelação Safra em 2024 e estamos entre os três melhores escritórios da rede.

Sobre a vaga

Mais do que uma vaga, este é um programa de formação. Uma trilha estruturada, com mentoria próxima e etapas claras, feita para transformar quem está no início de carreira em Assessor de Investimentos, pronto para conduzir a própria carteira de clientes.

Buscamos jovens com ambição, disciplina e vontade real de crescer. Aqui o crescimento é proporcional à sua dedicação e aos seus resultados, num ambiente meritocrático e de alta performance: quem entrega, cresce — profissional e financeiramente.

Como funciona a formação:

O programa é dividido em etapas, cada uma com acompanhamento e metas próprias:

  • Recebimento e fundamentos (primeiras semanas): você mergulha no mercado financeiro, nos produtos e no jeito de trabalhar do Safra, com marcos de acompanhamento.
  • Execução assistida: você começa a atuar com clientes ao lado de um mentor, aprendendo prospecção, relacionamento e construção de estratégias na prática.
  • Autonomia e certificação: você assume mais responsabilidade e se prepara para a certificação do mercado (ANCORD), passo obrigatório para atuar como Assessor.
  • Consolidação: você conduz um projeto próprio e fecha o ciclo pronto para ser efetivado como Assessor de Investimentos, com carteira própria.

Do começo ao fim, você terá um mentor direto acompanhando sua evolução de perto.

O que você vai fazer ao longo do programa

  • Aprender a prospectar e captar clientes, primeiro com apoio e depois com autonomia.
  • Construir relacionamento e entender os objetivos financeiros de cada investidor.
  • Montar estratégias alinhadas ao perfil e às necessidades de cada cliente.
  • Cuidar da experiência do cliente, com acompanhamento consultivo e soluções personalizadas.
  • Estudar o mercado e os produtos financeiros com profundidade, rumo à certificação.

Onde você chega

Ao final da formação, você termina o programa como Assessor de Investimentos certificado, pronto para conduzir a própria carteira dentro de uma assessoria credenciada pelo Banco Safra.

O que buscamos em você

  • Perfil comercial e gosto por negociar e se relacionar com pessoas.
  • Resiliência para lidar com ritmo intenso e com metas.
  • Interesse verdadeiro pelo mercado financeiro e por investimentos.
  • Iniciativa e senso de dono: vontade de fazer acontecer sem esperar que mandem.
  • Ambição de crescer acima da média, profissional e financeiramente.
  • Boa comunicação, na fala e na escrita.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.

Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.

Position Overview

We're looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.

What You'll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.

Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.

Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 57 years, we have been a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and sustainable value to our stakeholders around the world.

Perform regular rounds across the process plant to monitor system and equipment performance, ensuring stable operation and reporting any abnormal conditions.

title: Hostess
description:
Venha viver nosso propósito!

Na Hyatt, somos movidos pelo propósito de "cuidar das pessoas para que elas possam ser o seu melhor".

Nossa promessa está em entregarmos grandes experiências para nossos clientes, colegas e para a sociedade baseada em nossos valores.

  • Ser íntegro nos torna diferentes pois estamos prontos para falar e aceitar a verdade, honrando com os compromissos, responsabilidades e orgulho;
  • Somos empáticos pois antes de qualquer coisa, nos colocamos no lugar das pessoas com compaixão e honestidade;
  • Buscamos a todo instante ver as coisas de uma forma diferente, nos tornando criativos, curiosos e experimentando sem medo. Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo;
  • Prezamos por um ambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência!

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por hospitalidade para atuar como Hostess, sendo o primeiro contato dos hóspedes e clientes com nossos restaurantes. Procuramos profissionais com excelente comunicação, postura acolhedora e foco na excelência do atendimento, capazes de proporcionar uma experiência memorável desde a recepção até a acomodação dos clientes

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Recepcionar hóspedes e clientes com cordialidade e profissionalismo.
  • Realizar o controle de reservas, lista de espera e fluxo de ocupação dos restaurantes.
  • Conduzir os clientes até suas mesas, garantindo uma experiência acolhedora e personalizada.
  • Fornecer informações sobre os serviços, horários de funcionamento e experiências gastronômicas oferecidas pelo hotel.
  • Apoiar a equipe de Alimentos & Bebidas na organização do salão e na experiência dos clientes.
  • Gerenciar solicitações especiais, garantindo que as necessidades dos hóspedes sejam atendidas com excelência.
  • Manter comunicação constante com a equipe operacional para otimizar o atendimento e o fluxo de serviço.
  • Garantir que os padrões de atendimento e hospitalidade da marca sejam cumpridos.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência anterior em atendimento ao cliente, recepção, hostess ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Desejável experiência em hotelaria, restaurantes ou operações de luxo.
  • Inglês avançado ou Espanhol.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde Amil co-participativo e extensivo a 2 dependentes (filhos até 21 anos e cônjuge) e Odontológico Amil (conforme cobertura contratada, extensivo a dependentes);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível de acordo com as suas necessidades;
  • WellHub para atividades voltadas para saúde e bem-estar;
  • Uniforme lavado e passado em nossa Lavanderia;

  • Parceria com restaurantes próximos ao hotel;
  • Desconto nos serviços oferecidos pelo hotel (Restaurantes e SPA);

  • Oportunidades de Encarreiramento;
  • 12 diárias ao ano em qualquer hotel da marca Hyatt com direito a 2 acompanhantes, após o período de experiência

Pensamos em benefícios que impactem positivamente o bem-estar e saúde de nossos colaboradores, então também oferecemos:

title: Operador de Extrusora Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha fazer parte do nosso time Ecoflex!

A Ecoflex Embalagens acredita que uma boa embalagem vai além de proteger um produto: ela também deve contribuir para processos mais eficientes e para um futuro mais responsável.

Somos uma empresa do setor de embalagens localizada em Caieiras/SP. Trabalhamos diariamente com o propósito de proteger produtos, atender nossos clientes com qualidade e preservar o planeta.

Valorizamos a colaboração, o respeito, a responsabilidade, a segurança e a busca constante pela excelência. Acreditamos no desenvolvimento das pessoas e reconhecemos aqueles que demonstram comprometimento, vontade de aprender e dedicação ao trabalho.

Fazer parte da Ecoflex é integrar uma equipe próxima, contribuir diretamente para os resultados da empresa e encontrar oportunidades para aprender, crescer e se desenvolver profissionalmente.

Estamos em busca de um profissional experiente e responsável para integrar nossa equipe de Extrusão.

SOBRE A VAGA

Se você possui sólida experiência em extrusão de filmes plásticos pelo processo balão e busca uma empresa do setor de embalagens flexíveis na qual possa aplicar seus conhecimentos e continuar se desenvolvendo, esta oportunidade é para você!

Descrição de Atividades

  • Operar extrusoras de filmes plásticos tipo balão, Mono e Coex;
  • Realizar setups, regulagens e partidas de máquina;
  • Ajustar os parâmetros do processo, incluindo temperatura, pressão, velocidade e espessura do filme;
  • Controlar a estabilidade do balão durante todo o processo produtivo;
  • Acompanhar e garantir a qualidade do material produzido conforme as especificações da ordem de produção;
  • Efetuar trocas de matéria-prima e monitorar o consumo dos materiais durante a produção;
  • Trabalhar com matérias-primas virgens e recicladas;
  • Identificar e corrigir desvios no processo de extrusão;
  • Atuar na redução de perdas, refugos e desperdícios de matéria-prima;
  • Realizar os apontamentos e registros relacionados à produção;
  • Zelar pela conservação das máquinas, pela manutenção preventiva dos equipamentos e pela organização do setor;
  • Cumprir os procedimentos internos e as normas de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência mínima comprovada de 6 anos como Operador de Extrusora;
  • Experiência em extrusoras tipo balão, preferencialmente em equipamentos Mono e Coex;
  • Domínio do processo de extrusão de filmes em PEBD, PEBDL e PEAD;
  • Experiência com matérias-primas virgens e recicladas;
  • Conhecimento em setup, regulagem e partida de máquinas;
  • Conhecimento em controle de espessura e estabilidade do balão;
  • Domínio dos parâmetros do processo de extrusão;
  • Capacidade para identificar e corrigir desvios durante a produção;
  • Perfil proativo, responsável e comprometido com qualidade, segurança, produtividade e redução de perdas;
  • Organização, atenção e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.

POR QUE FAZER PARTE DA NOSSA EQUIPE?

Na Ecoflex, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Oportunidade de aplicar e ampliar seus conhecimentos técnicos;
  • Ambiente de trabalho próximo e colaborativo;
  • Possibilidade de crescimento por desempenho, dedicação e excelência;
  • Participação direta na melhoria dos processos e nos resultados da empresa;
  • Empresa comprometida com qualidade, segurança e responsabilidade ambiental;
  • Valorização de profissionais experientes, responsáveis e comprometidos.

HORÁRIO DE TRABALHO

  • Escala 3x3
  • 18h as 06h

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Vale-alimentação;
  • Vale-transporte ou ajuda de custo para combustível;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados — PLR.

VENHA PARTICIPAR DO NOSSO PROCESSO SELETIVO!

Se você se identifica com a nossa forma de trabalhar e deseja construir uma trajetória de aprendizado e crescimento, queremos conhecer você.

title: Tax Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Fiscal Tax Specialist serves as the primary technical expert for all tax-related matters, ensuring the company's full tax compliance while identifying opportunities for tax optimization, mitigating tax risks, and guaranteeing the accurate calculation, reporting, and payment of taxes. This position plays a strategic role in aligning tax practices with current legislation and the company's business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Tax Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure the accurate calculation, review, and timely submission of all tax returns and ancillary tax obligations.
  • Maintain compliance with federal, state, and municipal tax regulations.
  • Monitor changes in tax legislation and assess their impact on company operations.
  • Develop and maintain internal controls to ensure tax compliance and minimize tax exposure.
  • Serve as the technical lead during internal and external audits related to tax matters.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Experience

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in Tax/Fiscal functions.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Tax Specialist or senior tax advisory role.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian tax legislation and compliance requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Protheus ERP
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • SPED Fiscal
  • EFD Contributions
  • ECD (Digital Accounting Bookkeeping)
  • ECF (Digital Tax Accounting Bookkeeping)
  • Experience with tax audits, tax recovery projects, and tax planning initiatives.

Key Competencies

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen.
  • Ability to interpret and apply complex tax legislation.
  • Project management and process improvement capabilities.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and Operations teams.

title: Production Technician Trainee
description:
Position: Production Technician Trainee

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 57 years, we have been a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and sustainable value to our stakeholders around the world.

Job Purpose

Execute routine inspections and predictive/preventive maintenance activities on topside systems and equipment, ensuring safe and reliable operations in accordance with company procedures, permit-to-work requirements, and supervisor instructions.

Responsibilities

Perform routine rounds throughout the process plant to monitor system and equipment performance and report abnormal conditions.

Execute first-line maintenance on process systems and equipment in accordance with CMMS work orders, daily inspections, and supervisor instructions.

Conduct line walks to verify proper system isolations before Permit to Work (PTW) release.

Prepare systems and equipment for maintenance activities, including draining, cleaning, and purging prior to handover.

Perform preservation activities, visual inspections, vibration, temperature and noise checks, oil changes and top-ups, cleaning of filters, strainers, drains, and sight glasses, gasket replacement (when specific competency is not required), and paint touch-ups.

Ensure all activities are carried out in compliance with company procedures, SOPs, and safety requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, Chemical, or related Engineering fields, from a recognized educational institution.
  • Recent graduate with up to 2 years of graduation.
  • Basic knowledge of industrial operations, maintenance, process systems, or equipment inspection gained through academic studies, internships, or practical training.
  • Willingness to learn and develop technical skills in offshore operations, first-line maintenance, equipment inspections, and Permit to Work (PTW) procedures.
  • English: Intermediate (mandatory for Brazilian candidates).

Benefits

Meal and food allowances.

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay).

Life Insurance.

Annual Bonus.

Private Pension Plan.

Childcare Allowance.

Note: This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

description:
Founded in the early 90s, SgT is an international company owned by Worms Safety and headquartered in Hong Kong. SgT specialises in apparel, textile and footwear, providing quality management solutions to major fashion brands, retailers and distributors worldwide.

SgT operates across 20 textile-production countries and employs more than 500 garment experts, technicians, textile engineers, QA professionals and auditors. Our solutions help customers secure the safety, quality and conformity of their products.

  • Solid understanding of quality-management systems and process-control verification.

  • Ability to work independently and travel locally to factory sites when needed.
  • Strong report-writing and communication skills.
  • English-reporting ability is an advantage.

title: Plant Operations Manager
description:
About Teknia – We are a multinational industrial company specialising in manufacturing metal and plastic components for mobility. Founded in 1992, we operate 21 production plants across 11 countries and employ more than 3,500 professionals. By combining a wide range of technologies, we collaborate with the leading manufacturers in the global automotive sector.

We are the sum of our factories and the people who make them possible. A growing company that has evolved thanks to the commitment and talent of our people.

About the Position – We are looking to hire an Industrialization Manager to join our team in our TEPEJI DEL RIO PLANT (MEXICO).

The selected candidate will lead operations and capital investment projects while ensuring plant readiness for new product launches and production requirements. They will drive operational excellence across the plant, guaranteeing the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets in line with customer expectations and business objectives. The role will also be responsible for promoting continuous improvement initiatives, operational efficiency, and compliance with automotive industry standards.

The responsibilities of the position include:

  • Lead small, medium, and large-scale industrialization and capital investment projects using project management methodologies.
  • Ensure plant readiness for new product launches and production requirements.
  • Coordinate production line modifications and engineering change management activities.
  • Manage contractors, suppliers, and internal resources involved in projects.
  • Control project budgets, capital expenditures, and investment execution.
  • Collaborate closely with internal departments, suppliers, and customers to achieve project and operational objectives.
  • Lead plant operations, ensuring compliance with production schedules and operational targets.
  • Drive the implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, and TPM initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with automotive quality standards, including IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, and SPC.
  • Lead audits and oversee corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Promote a strong safety culture, cost control, and talent development across the organization.
  • Monitor and improve operational KPIs to enhance plant performance and competitiveness.

Experience and Education

  • Academic Background: Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field. A Master's Degree is considered an advantage.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar leadership role and 8-10 years of experience within the automotive industry.
  • Proven experience managing plant operations, preferably within Die Casting and Machining environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Continuous Improvement methodologies, KPI management, and Project Management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing large-scale industrialization projects.
  • Language Skills: Fluent English.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.
  • Strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to operational challenges.
  • Ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

If you're looking for a dynamic environment and a project with international scope, Teknia is the ideal place for you. We look forward to receiving your application!

About the Role

This is not a process-coordination role.

You will own the end-to-end operational infrastructure supporting Velaro's cross-border payment flows — from funding and liquidity to settlement, payout and reconciliation.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Finance, Commercial teams, as well as banks, payment providers, liquidity partners and other financial counterparties to ensure every transaction is executed reliably, efficiently and compliantly.

More importantly, you will help us turn operational complexity into scalable systems.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the operational execution of cross-border transactions across fiat and digital asset rails, including funding, FX conversion, stablecoin settlement, local payout and transaction completion.
  • Ensure transactions are settled accurately and on time. Build robust reconciliation, exception management and escalation processes across bank accounts, wallets, payment providers and counterparties.
  • Coordinate closely with Treasury, banking partners, payment providers, OTC and liquidity partners to ensure sufficient liquidity and reliable execution across payment corridors.
  • Design SOPs, controls, workflows and operational playbooks that allow Velaro to scale transaction volume and enter new markets without scaling manual work at the same rate.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and work closely with Product and Engineering to turn operational requirements into systems and tooling.
  • Own the operational response to failed, delayed or unusual transactions.
  • Establish escalation procedures, business continuity plans and incident-response frameworks to maintain reliable payment operations across markets and time zones.
  • Manage the operational relationship with banks, payment providers, exchanges, liquidity providers and other infrastructure partners.
  • Monitor partner performance, resolve operational issues and identify infrastructure gaps as Velaro expands into new corridors.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in payments, fintech, banking, treasury operations, FX or financial infrastructure
  • Experience leading payment or financial operations in a fast-growing environment
  • Strong understanding of cross-border payment flows, settlement and reconciliation
  • Hands-on experience working with banks, PSPs, payment networks, FX providers or liquidity partners
  • Familiarity with both traditional financial rails and digital asset / stablecoin settlement
  • Experience operating in regulated financial environments, with a practical understanding of KYC/KYB, AML and operational risk controls
  • Proven ability to design and scale operational processes, SOPs and controls
  • Strong analytical mindset and experience building operational KPIs and dashboards
  • Ability to manage incidents and make sound decisions under pressure
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across business, technical, compliance and external partner teams
  • Professional fluency in English and Portuguese

Nice to Have

  • Experience in B2B cross-border payments, trade payments or treasury infrastructure
  • Experience with Latin American payment markets, particularly Brazil and PIX
  • Experience with stablecoins, digital assets, on/off-ramp infrastructure or OTC settlement
  • Experience launching new payment corridors or markets
  • Familiarity with API-based payment infrastructure and operational automation
  • Mandarin proficiency

title: Analista de Trading Energia Sênior
description:

Somos a ArcelorMittal, maior produtora de aço do Brasil e uma empresa global que atua com o propósito de produzir aços inteligentes para as pessoas e para o planeta. title: Performance Video Editor | DTC E-commerce
description:
Performance Video Editor | DTC E-commerce

Work Schedule: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week) | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST

Location: Remote | LATAM & Philippines

Type: Full-Time / Long-Term Contract

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing DTC e-commerce company specializing in consumer products, with a strong presence across major retail channels.

They are looking for a Performance Video Editor to join their creative team and produce high-performing video ads for Meta, Instagram, and TikTok. This is a great opportunity for an editor who understands that performance creative is about more than making a video look good—it's about creating content that captures attention, communicates value quickly, and drives conversions.

The team produces a high volume of advertising creatives, so we are looking for someone who is creative, efficient, proactive, and comfortable generating new ideas and testing different approaches.

What You'll Do

Video Editing & Performance Creative

  • Edit short-form direct-response video ads for Meta, Instagram, and TikTok.
  • Transform raw footage, creator content, scripts, and product footage into engaging advertising creatives.
  • Build strong hooks, pacing, re-hooks, visual storytelling, and CTAs designed to improve viewer retention and conversions.
  • Create multiple variations of creative concepts to support testing and optimization.
  • Source and incorporate relevant B-roll, stock footage, graphics, and other visual assets.
  • Adapt content for different platforms, placements, and formats.
  • Continuously improve creative based on feedback and performance insights.

Creative & Design

  • Create compelling visual assets that support video ads and marketing campaigns.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in typography, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
  • Use Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar tools when needed.
  • Contribute new creative concepts and ideas for advertising campaigns.

Collaboration & Workflow

  • Organize and manage creative assets efficiently.
  • Follow established file naming and organization standards.
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions.
  • Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to execute a high volume of advertising content.
  • Be open to feedback and continuously look for ways to improve creative quality and workflow efficiency.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience, ideally focused on short-form content.
  • Strong experience creating direct-response / performance video ads.
  • Proven experience editing Facebook/Meta Ads.
  • At least 1 year of experience working with a DTC or e-commerce brand.
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills.
  • Strong understanding of short-form advertising creative and what makes people stop scrolling.
  • Experience working with product-focused advertising.
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar design tools.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, storytelling, typography, composition, and motion graphics.
  • Ability to take a script or creative concept and turn it into an engaging visual story.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality work consistently.
  • Fluent English, both written and verbal.
  • Strong time management and ability to meet daily and weekly deadlines.
  • Proactive, creative, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback and iterating quickly.
  • Portfolio required, with relevant performance video examples.

Strongly Preferred Experience

  • We will prioritize candidates who have created advertising content for DTC/e-commerce brands, especially products such as:
  • Home and household products
  • Cleaning products
  • Pet-related products
  • Consumer electronics
  • Other physical consumer products
  • Experience creating Meta advertising creative is especially valuable.
  • Candidates whose experience is primarily in corporate video, traditional media, film, or organic social content without meaningful performance advertising experience are unlikely to be a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is not necessarily the most senior editor in the market. We are looking for someone with strong performance instincts, creativity, and good judgment who can understand a product, identify what will grab attention, and turn that insight into effective advertising creative.

You should be someone who:

  • Thinks beyond simply following a script.
  • Can come up with fresh creative ideas and angles.
  • Understands the difference between organic content and direct-response advertising.
  • Is comfortable testing hooks, formats, pacing, and creative concepts.
  • Learns quickly and applies feedback.
  • Can produce a high volume of quality creative without sacrificing attention to detail.

Tech Requirements

  • Computer: i7 processor or equivalent with at least 16GB RAM
  • Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum.

Schedule

  • Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)
  • Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST

Hiring Process

  • Candidates who move forward should be comfortable completing the following steps:
  • Skills Assessment
  • Trial Project
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Final Offer

The trial project will be used to evaluate editing quality, performance instincts, creativity, and technical execution.

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully Remote
  • Full-Time, Long-Term Opportunity
  • Paid Time Off
  • Flex Days
  • Professional Development – Opportunities to learn and grow with the business
  • Opportunity to work directly on high-volume DTC performance advertising

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: Head of design

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

They recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We are looking for an exceptional individual to help design, build and scale Nova's next generation of products, working closely with the founders and the greater founding team. We're looking for an outstanding product designer who will:

  • Lead the design of payment experiences for both consumers and merchants, across mobile apps and desktop platforms, from research to polished, shipped product
  • Help shape Nova's product vision and design direction, influencing decisions beyond your own projects.
  • Raise the design quality bar across the product, mentoring others and improving how the whole team ships UI.
  • Operate as an important IC designer, partnering directly with founders and leaders on product vision• Build and evolve design systems ensuring scalable, accessible, and delightful UIs.
  • Prototype and test ideas rapidly, validating hypotheses with real users.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering to align design decisions with business outcomes.
  • Share work frequently in constructive design critiques and contribute to our design culture of openness and iteration.
  • Occasionally support brand and marketing initiatives (landing pages, campaigns) when your craft can raise the bar.

This is your chance to be a key player at work, working on challenging projects with significant impact, as part of a select team of members at an ambitious and unique new payment network company.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years designing digital products with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, including mobile interfaces.
  • Strong visual and interaction design craft with systematic thinking.• Daily use of AI in your design workflow (research, synthesis, spec'ing, prototyping).
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments, balancing high quality with speed.
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Preferred:

  • Experience building and shipping production-quality interfaces with AI coding tools (Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, v0, etc.), reducing or removing the need for front-end handoff.
  • Experience in fintech or payments in Brazil.
  • Background in early-stage startups, especially in 0→1 environments.
  • Familiarity with user research, testing, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase).

The Target Companies

Candidates with at least 2 years of full-time experience in the companies below will be prioritized:

  • Strong Fintechs: Nubank, Revolut, Wise, Mercado Pago, Brex, Itaú, Cora
  • Strong Local Digital Product Companies: QuintoAndar, iFood, Wildlife, Mercado Livre, Globo
  • Strong Design Consultancies: Work&Co, Metalab, Huge, R/GA, Accenture Song
  • Big Tech: Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft
  • Other Tech: Notion, Netflix, Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Spotify, Snap, X (Twitter), Pinterest

The Selection Process

Materials about Nova, including a pitch deck and pitch videos will be made available through the process

Portfolio Review: Async review of your portfolio by the design team to assess craft, depth of thinking, and end-to-end product work. Portfolio is required.

Screening Call: 15 min call with HR for alignment on requirements and qualifications.

Deep Dive Interview: 60 min call with Hiring Manager to deep dive on past experiences and profile.

Bar Raiser Interview: 45 min call with another leader to validate assessment with a 2nd opinion.

Cultural Fit Interview: 30 min call with CEO to evaluate culture fit and answer questions about Nova.

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: SBS Operations Senior Manager
description:
At Sherwin-Williams, we color the world! With more than 150 years of global excellence, we are a leader in the paints and coatings industry, recognized for innovation, quality, and our commitment to sustainability.

We are seeking an experienced SBS Operations Senior Manager to lead and advance our Shared Business Services operations across Brazil. This role partners closely with SBS Service Delivery teams and business leaders to drive service excellence, operational effectiveness, and strategic growth.

The SBS Operations Senior Manager plays a critical role in overseeing regional service delivery, managing demand pipelines, capacity planning, service placement strategies, and supporting key SBS initiatives across Brazil. This leader will also be responsible for monitoring and improving Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring the organization consistently delivers high-quality, efficient, and scalable services. Beyond operational leadership, this role is empowered to drive transformation through influence, collaboration, communication, and execution. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the successful candidate will champion process standardization, harmonization, optimization, and automation, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, strong governance, and operational excellence.

We are looking for a strategic and influential leader who thrives in complex environments, builds strong partnerships across Finance, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, and is passionate about developing high-performing teams while driving meaningful business impact across Brazil and LATAM.

São Bernardo do Campo, SP, Brazil | Hybrid (3x2)

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage regional processes, business requirements, documentation, playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge repositories. Manage and continuously enhance SBS processes within the service catalog, including the evaluation of current services, regional systems, taxonomies, tools, business process master lists, and repository governance.
  • Lead the execution of the regional transition program, focusing on process standardization, harmonization, streamlining, optimization, and control analysis. Partner closely with SBS Service Delivery teams to identify, design, and implement process improvement initiatives and supporting tools.
  • Prepare and manage the facility budget, process facility-related charges, and monitor expenditures throughout the year to ensure proper financial oversight and cost control.
  • Partner with SBS leadership to build the foundation for the organization and support its continued growth and maturity, driving sustainable operational capabilities and organizational effectiveness.
  • Execute regional transition initiatives to ensure smooth service transfers, effective stakeholder alignment, and seamless handoffs between teams.
  • Develop and implement programs that strengthen operational excellence capabilities, including the assessment, design, and deployment of training initiatives. Promote consistent ways of working, cross-functional collaboration, waste reduction, process standardization, and risk mitigation.
  • Serve as a senior influencer across global, regional, and local leadership teams. Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of standardized SBS processes and operating models. Build strong partnerships across Finance, SBS, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, while effectively communicating vision, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  • Build and develop high-performing teams across LATAM. Drive initiatives that enhance operational excellence capabilities, professional development, and organizational effectiveness. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and learning.

Education

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • MBA, CPA, or other advanced professional certification.

Knowledge & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance, Shared Services, Operations, or a related business function, with a proven track record in operational excellence, process management, transformation, and business partnership.
  • Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills. Spanish proficiency is preferred.
  • Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, build cross-functional relationships, and drive alignment across global, regional, and local teams.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams both directly and through influence in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience within a Shared Services Center (SSC), multinational organization, or business transformation environment is highly desirable.
  • Previous people leadership experience and exposure to transition management, continuous improvement, and change management initiatives are preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of end-to-end business processes, including areas such as Record-to-Report (RTR), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Hire-to-Retire (HTR), and other Shared Services processes.
  • Understanding of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and performance management frameworks.
  • Experience developing execution strategies, operating procedures, governance models, and process documentation.
  • Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, process standardization, and operational excellence principles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Shared Services technologies, workflow tools, automation solutions, and ERP platforms.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience supporting automation, digital transformation, or process optimization initiatives.

About Us

At Sherwin-Williams, our purpose is to inspire and improve the world by coloring and protecting what matters. Our paints, coatings, and innovative solutions make the places and spaces in our world brighter and stronger. Your skills, talent, and passion make it possible for you to live this purpose while enabling our customers and our company to achieve exceptional results.

Sherwin-Williams recognizes your dedication, growth, and ambition and translates them into opportunities for our team. Our people are the foundation of our success, and we invest in and support you:

In your life... with recognition, benefits, and flexibility to improve your health and well-being.

title: Online Teacher - Whole Child Education | IWS Online School
description:
We are not looking for a teacher. At least, not in the traditional sense.

At IWS Online School, we are hiring teachers across all subjects, and we are looking for people who genuinely care about children and believe education is about much more than delivering a curriculum.

We are looking for someone who notices when a child is quieter than usual. Someone who celebrates the small victories. Someone who understands that confidence, curiosity, character and belonging matter just as much as academic progress.

You may have many years of teaching experience.

You may have relatively little.

That is not the first thing we look at.

We can provide training in curriculum delivery, assessment, pedagogy, online teaching practice, technology and classroom management.

What is much harder to train is:

  • Genuine care for children
  • Empathy and emotional awareness
  • Positive energy and warmth
  • Strong character and responsibility
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn
  • A real desire to make a difference in a child's life

The role

You will teach small groups of students online in your subject area and take responsibility for both their academic progress and their wider development.

This includes:

  • Delivering engaging, high-quality online lessons
  • Teaching your specialist subject effectively
  • Building strong relationships with students
  • Understanding each child as an individual
  • Monitoring progress and providing meaningful feedback
  • Supporting confidence, independence and curiosity
  • Working collaboratively with the wider IWS team
  • Communicating effectively with students, colleagues and families
  • Participating in training and continuous professional development

Who we are looking for

We are recruiting across a wide range of subjects, including core academic subjects, languages, humanities, sciences, technology, creative subjects and other specialist areas.

What matters most is not simply what you teach.

It is how you make children feel while they are learning.

We want teachers who see the child before the lesson.

There is a real young person on the other side of the screen, living one year of their childhood that will never come back.

We take that responsibility seriously.

Our aim is not simply to cover content. We want children to leave IWS stronger, more confident, more curious and better prepared for the world ahead of them.

If that is the kind of education you believe in, we would like to hear from you.

When applying, alongside your CV, tell us about one thing you have done for a child that you are still proud of.

Not your best lesson.

The child.

Na Ecoflex, você terá a oportunidade de:

title: Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência - Ponta Grossa/PR

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Sobre a WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Onde o fornecimento começa

Fundada em 1999, a WIN SOURCE ajuda fabricantes a garantir componentes eletrônicos críticos e a construir cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes em um mercado global cada vez mais complexo, com o apoio de uma equipe global de mais de 450 colaboradores.

Por meio da NEXUSTM, nossa plataforma inteligente para a cadeia de suprimentos, e de nossa rede mundial de recursos de sourcing, estoque e logística, ajudamos os clientes a tomar decisões de aquisição mais inteligentes, fortalecer a continuidade do fornecimento e responder com confiança aos desafios de um mercado em constante evolução.

Atualmente, a WIN SOURCE atende clientes em todo o mundo por meio de operações estrategicamente localizadas na Ásia, Europa e América do Norte, instalações certificadas e um forte compromisso com a qualidade, a confiabilidade e a excelência operacional.

Sobre a função

A função de Gerente de Vendas Internacionais na WIN SOURCE concentra-se na construção de parcerias estratégicas com OEMs globais, empresas de serviços de manufatura eletrônica (EMS) e empresas de tecnologia, ajudando os clientes a solucionar desafios complexos relacionados ao fornecimento de componentes eletrônicos. Ao atuar com clientes dos setores de infraestrutura de IA, automotivo, industrial, médico e de eletrônicos avançados, o profissional contribui para a continuidade da produção e para programas críticos nos quais o fornecimento confiável de componentes é essencial.

Esta posição desempenha um papel importante no apoio aos clientes na aquisição de componentes, gestão de escassez, mitigação de riscos de fim de vida (EOL), otimização de listas de materiais (BOM) e soluções de continuidade do fornecimento. Isso é feito em colaboração com as equipes globais de sourcing, compras e qualidade da WIN SOURCE, contribuindo para cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes que impulsionam a inovação em diversos setores.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes globais e impulsionar o crescimento sustentável dos negócios nos mercados sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Gerenciar toda a jornada de vendas, desde o desenvolvimento de mercado e o relacionamento com clientes até a gestão de solicitações de cotação (RFQs), negociação e fechamento.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com OEMs, empresas de serviços de manufatura eletrônica (EMS) e equipes de engenharia e compras para oferecer soluções confiáveis para o fornecimento de componentes eletrônicos.
  • Ajudar os clientes a enfrentar desafios na cadeia de suprimentos, incluindo escassez, riscos de fim de vida (EOL), transições de ciclo de vida e otimização de custos.

Por que fazer parte da WIN SOURCE

Na WIN SOURCE, seu trabalho gera valor que vai além das vendas. Você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Atuar em desafios reais da cadeia de suprimentos nos mercados automotivo, industrial, médico e de eletrônicos avançados.
  • Construir relacionamentos estratégicos com profissionais de engenharia, compras e cadeia de suprimentos em todo o mundo.
  • Utilizar a rede global de sourcing e o conhecimento de mercado da WIN SOURCE para oferecer soluções que vão além da distribuição tradicional.
  • Desenvolver sua carreira em uma organização global, na qual seu trabalho contribui para cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes e para as tecnologias do futuro.

O que buscamos

  • Ter 3 anos ou mais de experiência em vendas B2B, gestão de contas, desenvolvimento de negócios ou outras funções comerciais relacionadas, com capacidade comprovada de desenvolver clientes e impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios.

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e construção de relacionamentos, com capacidade para compreender as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções orientadas à geração de valor.
  • Mentalidade focada no cliente, forte visão comercial e capacidade de gerenciar oportunidades ao longo de todo o ciclo de vendas.
  • Paixão por vendas internacionais e desenvolvimento de negócios, com atitude proativa, forte senso de responsabilidade e motivação para criar valor de longo prazo em um ambiente global.

Benefícios e crescimento profissional

Na WIN SOURCE, reconhecemos e recompensamos as pessoas que geram impacto.

Oferecemos:

  • Salário-base competitivo e estrutura de comissões sem limite, permitindo que profissionais de alto desempenho maximizem seu potencial de ganhos.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins

Founded in 1999, WIN SOURCE helps manufacturers secure critical electronic components and build more resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex global market,supported by a global team of 450+ employees.

Through NEXUSTM, our intelligent supply chain platform, and our worldwide network of sourcing, inventory and logistics capabilities, we help customers make smarter sourcing decisions, strengthen supply continuity and respond confidently to evolving market challenges.

Today, WIN SOURCE serves customers worldwide through strategically located operations across Asia, Europe and North America, certified facilities and a strong commitment to quality, reliability and operational excellence.

About the Role

The International Sales Manager role at WIN SOURCE focuses on building strategic partnerships with global OEMs, EMS providers and technology companies while helping customers solve complex electronic component supply challenges. Working with customers across AI infrastructure, automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics sectors, this role helps customers maintain production continuity and support critical programs where reliable component supply is essential.

This position plays an important role in supporting customers with component sourcing, shortage management, EOL risk mitigation, BOM optimization and supply continuity solutions through collaboration with WIN SOURCE's global sourcing, procurement and quality teams, and build more resilient supply chains that support innovation across industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strategic relationships with global customers and drive sustainable business growth across assigned markets.
  • Manage the complete sales journey, from market development and customer engagement to RFQ management, negotiation and closing.
  • Partner with OEMs, EMS providers, engineering and procurement teams to deliver reliable electronic component sourcing solutions.
  • Help customers navigate supply chain challenges, including shortages, EOL risks, lifecycle transitions and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with global teams and represent WIN SOURCE at customer meetings and industry events.

Why Join WIN SOURCE

At WIN SOURCE, your work creates value beyond sales. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Connect with global technology companies and help secure the critical components that keep industries moving.
  • Work on real supply chain challenges across automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics markets.
  • Build strategic relationships with global engineering, procurement and supply chain professionals.
  • Leverage WIN SOURCE's global sourcing network and market expertise to deliver solutions beyond traditional distribution.
  • Grow your career in a global organization where your work contributes to more resilient supply chains and future technologies.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, business development or related commercial roles, with a proven ability to develop customers and drive business growth.
  • Experience in electronic components, semiconductors, electronics distribution, EMS or manufacturing supply chains is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver value-driven solutions.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
  • Passion for international sales and business development, with a proactive mindset, strong ownership and the drive to create long-term value in a global environment.

Benefits & Career Growth

At WIN SOURCE, we recognize and reward people who create impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped commission structure, giving high performers the opportunity to maximize their earning potential.
  • Global sales opportunities with international customers, strategic accounts and exposure to worldwide electronics markets.
  • The opportunity to work at the center of the global electronics supply chain, helping manufacturers secure critical components and solve real business challenges.
  • Professional training, industry knowledge development and a clear career path toward commercial leadership.
  • Opportunities to participate in 50+ international exhibitions, customer meetings and global business activities.
  • A multicultural and collaborative environment with teams across Asia, Europe and North America.
  • Career development path: Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → Senior Regional Sales Manager → Global Sales Leadership

Join WIN SOURCE

Ready to grow your international sales career and make an impact in the global electronics supply chain?

Apply today and join WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins.

Submit your application through LinkedIn or send your resume to:

Follow WIN SOURCE on LinkedIn for the latest company updates, industry insights and career opportunities.
